title: Quintessential Indulgent Egyptian Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Egyptian dish made with lamb, ginger garlic paste, and spices, cooked in a copper pot and served with a side of anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a copper pot over medium heat and sear the lamb pieces until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion to the copper pot and cook until softened.
Add the ginger garlic paste to the copper pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped dried apricots and prunes to the copper pot and stir to combine.
Cover the copper pot and transfer it to the preheated tandoor or oven.
Cook the tagine for 2 1/2 hours or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
